measurementRules.rule: Calibrated complete net mass at unique first release; subtract actual removable packaging tare, retain real permanent parts/water; released closingFG already lies in Q.
Preserve mass/energy/volume numerator units; Mass/kg does not apply to electricity or atmospheric-water resource. Raw conversion and real attribution precede the sole quotient.

measurementRules.applies_to: all actual count volume or area observations
measurementRules.rule: Item(s) and item for Number of items are factor1 count aliases only, not kg. A needed count-to-kg conversion requires calibrated same-configuration whole net M with conditioning/scope, not a secondary coefficient. Integrated volume is not multiplied by time again; only true rates are integrated; density is independent for that substance/state. Area means actual single-side projection and L*W only proven rectangles; this Q is not area.

Carrier water, active and pieces included in a bought preparation/bag/label/eye assembly are child accounts only; genuine onsite formulation or separate parts are separate purchases. Declare dry/wet state, complete gates and X dedup.

calculationRules.rule: Retain original readings first. Convert kWh*3.6 to MJ; convert a real rate by time integration once; use integrated volume directly. Use independent substance/state density only when converting actual volume to mass; never native secondary screening coefficients or assumed item mass. Preserve each actual native extensive unit.

Q=sum actual calibrated net kg of unique complete first-released conforming toys; released closingFG is included once; unreleased WIP and specimens destroyed before first acceptance are excluded; specimens destroyed after first acceptance remain in original Q with their actual loss and disposition.

For each exchange vector A_c=B_open+U-B_close-T_other. B covers raw material/WIP and unassigned nonWIP material/service charge only, never already released FG. U is actual new burden additions, not already stock-corrected consumption. T_other requires a real independent other cohort/function and justified once-only handover; ordinary waste/samples/sale do not qualify. If consumption already stock-corrected, use that equivalent ledger without subtracting stock twice.

A_H=actual original-cohort increments+opening unused_unassigned_charge-closing unused_unassigned_charge-justified_other_function_handover. Preserve original first-release history once; incurred service is not closingFG carry. Original Q_H is the actual original cohort mass and H the observed horizon, not current shipment/return/repaired mass.

q_phys=V_i/Qanalysis is a diagnostic of the once-only full physical event with declared positive observation basis; model q_b=A_c/Q0_c or A_H/Q_H uses the distinct evidenced attributable vector and each original positive cohort mass exactly once. Shared whole receiver/provider quantity is recorded once; no full event recharge to every cohort. out_toy remains the 1 kg reference. Zero or unknown basis retains raw totals and no unit result.

For each material pool opening_empty_attachedWIP_attachedFG_reusable + P + I + ER + actual_disjoint_retained_repair_water_increments = closing_empty_attachedWIP_attachedFG_reusable + S + EO + W + actual_disjoint_departures. Internal attachment/reuse cancels; P/I/ER are disjoint. Whole wet incoming article and full wet closing stock both remain even when new material/water is retained. X only deduplicates overlap with other same-side flow terms. Mixed W origins do not add to the already-inclusive total outlet.

Manufacture: opening raw/WIP material + actual incoming material/water/species = closing raw/WIP/unassigned stores + first-release whole Q + real waste/species outputs. FG/service: opening complete FG + internal Q handoff + gross external returns + disjoint new parts/water = closing complete FG/repairWIP + gross dispatch/external returns + actual waste/species. At consolidation cancel Q/internal component/waste/packaging pairs; never add whole wet article plus its included constituents or Q plus closing releasedFG as new output. Asset/packaging stocks are their own complete gates.

Reconcile whole wet/dry physical mass and relevant elements independently of actual molecular/reaction/phase evidence. Actual moisture exchange, free/retained/reaction/structural water each needs independent state evidence; no one residual fits two unknowns. Preserve gas gross inlet/outlet and non-additive mixture bridge; COD/VOC and particle indicators remain indicators, not molecular masses.

measurementRules.rule: 校准秤测唯一首次放行完整净质量；去实际可拆包装皮重，含实在永久部件/水；closingFG已在Q内。
质量、能量和体积保留各自分子单位；Mass/kg不强加电力或大气水资源。原始换算和真实归属先于唯一商。

measurementRules.applies_to: all actual count volume or area observations
measurementRules.rule: Number of items的Item(s)与item因子1仅件数等价，不给kg。若需每件转kg，校准同配置完整净M并保留调理/范围，不从次级属性猜重量。积分体积不再乘时间，真实速率才积分，密度为该物质状态独立实测。面积仅真实单面投影，LW仅证实矩形；本Q不用面积。
外购整制剂/袋/标签/眼装配件含的载水、活性及部件仅子账；实际现场配制或独立部件才另购。干/湿状态、完整关口及X去重均须声明。

calculationRules.rule: 先保留原读数；kWh乘3.6转MJ，真实速率仅积分一次，已积分体积直接用。真实体积转质量仅用独立物质/状态密度，不用原生次级筛查系数或假定件重，保留各原生广延单位。
Q=唯一首次合格放行完整玩具校准实测净kg之和，已放行closingFG已含一次；未放行WIP和首次验收前毁损试样不入，首次验收后销毁试样仍在原Q并保留实际损失及去向。
逐交换向量A_c=B_open+U-B_close-T_other。B仅原料/WIP及未分配非WIP材料/服务费用，绝不含已放行FG；U为真实新增负荷，不是已库存校正耗用。T_other须真实独立其他cohort/功能及正当一次移交，普通废物/样品/销售不符。已校正耗用用其等价账，不二扣库存。
A_H=原cohort实际增量+期初未用未分配费用-期末未用未分配费用-正当其他功能移交。原首次放行历史保留一次，已发生服务不作closingFG结转；原Q_H为真实原cohort质量，H为观察期，不是本次发运/退回/修后质量。
q_phys=V_i/Qanalysis仅为完整实物事件按声明正观察基准的诊断；模型q_b=A_c/Q0_c或A_H/Q_H仅将独立有据可归属向量除各原正批次质量一次。共享接收/供方完整量仅记录一次，不向每批重复全额。out_toy仍为1 kg参考；零或未知基准保留原总量且无单位结果。
逐材料池期初空包装附着WIP附着FG周转+P+I+ER+实际互斥滞留修补水增量=同状态期末+S+EO+W+实际互斥减量。内部附着/复用抵消，P/I/ER互不重叠；新增料水即使留存，整份湿态流入和完整湿态期末量均保留。X只对同侧其他流项重叠去重。混合W来源不再叠加于已含总出口。
制造：期初原料/WIP实物+真实入料/水/物种=期末原料/WIP/未分配库存+首次放行整件Q+真实废物/物种流出。FG/服务：期初整FG+内部Q交接+毛外退收货+不重叠新增件/水=期末整FG/repairWIP+毛发运/对外退还+真实废物/物种。合并抵消Q/内部组成/废物/包材配对，不能叠加整湿件及其组成或Q和已放行closingFG作新输出，资产/包装各自完整关口。
完整湿/干物理质量及相关元素守恒独立于真实分子/反应/相态证据。实际湿度交换、游离/留存/反应/结构水各需独立状态证据，不能一残差解两未知。保留气体毛进出及不可加和混合桥；COD/VOC和颗粒指标仍是指标而非分子质量。

collectionProtocols.temporal_coverage: 完整报告期含失败/零产出/启停/待机/清理及真实跨期库存
collectionProtocols.quality_evidence: 校准/溯源; 供方规格; 原票据; 事件去重; 各门平衡; 不确定性/缺失; 真实状态/处置

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 保留全部原生名称/同义词/备注/CAS/形态/路线/等级/地理/介质/type及每个属性到组到单位链，每卡消费时带精确限制。空辅料身份在具体数据使用前实际匹配，不证明核心不存在。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 精确公开身份原件及实际供方规格

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 使用完整primary原件及相邻反例，区分历史指导、产品案例和场址实测，不无证据借配方、排放因子、再生比例、安全批准或数量。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 完整primary范围及真实前景记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 归一化前采完整事件及校准原数量，含失败/零产出/启停/待机/清理、库存和逐交换继承向量，明确缺失/不确定性及真实缺省证据。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 原仪表/秤/ERP/检验/处置记录

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 毛实物流与负荷归属分开，供方/处理所有者唯一、整件桥互不重叠；普通废物销售、FG留库或未授权失败作业均不抹真实负荷。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 所有权矩阵及独立质量/向量平衡

dataQualityRequirements.requirement: 声明实际场址/时间、产品配置、供方状态、公用合同、排放介质、覆盖缺口与供方不确定性，不编未来工厂量、名义默认或隐含零；主路线改变需复评。
dataQualityRequirements.evidence: 数据集元数据及可追溯原记录
